elevate.move: Make the photography the shade line's subject: one real frame per hour band, each clipped by the diagonal seam at its hour's angle, warm-graded on the sunlit side and cool on the shaded side, so the frames read as one day on one roof

Make the clock run: one scroll-driven --sw-hour rotates the seam across every band and ticks the header sun-clock in step, so the scroll visibly moves the sun from 05:00 to 23:00, static noon angle under reduced motion
